title: RejectedArchiveRecord
description: Registro de finding interceptado antes de Phase 1 por ser unrecoverable tras el recovery agent. additionalProperties: false to prevent silent drift in records that feed Inventory Mapping operations downstream.

reason_code.description: Reason this finding was routed to rejected_archive. unrecoverable_after_recovery means the recovery agent exhausted all strategies; distinct from could_not_verify (pre-recovery, no attempt made).

source_finding_id.description: item_id from the part_4 finding (e.g. F-X01). Together with shard_id, uniquely identifies this record.

shard_id.description: shard_id from the part_4 finding. Together with source_finding_id, uniquely identifies this record.

source_tool.description: source_tool value from the part_4 finding. Expected value: gpt_custom (recovery agent output).

seller_or_subject.description: Subject of the failed finding, verbatim from the part_4 finding.

attempted.description: Strategies attempted by the recovery agent, verbatim from the part_4 finding attempted field.

why_failed.description: Failure mode, verbatim from the part_4 finding why_failed field. May be empty string or null.

urls_mentioned.description: URLs encountered during recovery attempts, verbatim from the part_4 finding.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this record was written to rejected_archive (YYYY-MM-DD).
